discovery_notes: 35 WebSearch calls, all claims from search snippets (no page reads). Mousesteps/MickeyBlog/Laughing Place entries are pre-release monthly schedules, so dates are planned. Conflicts: Nov 2021 PTT location Alamo Trading Post (DPB) vs Davy Crockett Ranch (MickeyBlog); Oct 2022 MyCastleClub page shows two conflicting schedules; Rainbow 2021 jumbo LE400/EUR50 from a garbled snippet. Leads not recorded as claims: WDWNT 30th anniv set of six golden medallions LE 1000 (pin status unclear); DPB says a Rainbow Flag jumbo LE 2500 first released at DLP before WDW Aug 2020 (DLP year unknown); reseller-only claims (30th castle LE 700, World of Frozen LE 1000, Orlinski Simba LE 500) ignored. Gaps: Apr-Jul 2020 (closure), early 2021 (closure), Feb/May/Jul/Sep 2022 detail, Oct-Nov 2023 LEs, Disney Hotel New York and Disneyland Hotel reopening pins, Pin Trading Nights. No instructional content seen.
